topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The walls of the office seem to close in as I sit across from Professor Thompson. My hands, clammy, grip the edges of my chair. My breath comes in short, shallow bursts, each one feeling louder than the last. Professor Thompson’s eyes, usually warm with interest, are now distant, critical. “We’ve detected a striking similarity between your essay and another source,” she says, her voice steady, but I can hear the unspoken weight of the accusation. I try to form a coherent response, but the words get stuck in my throat. I know I should speak up, explain the countless hours I spent on this, but the silence grows, heavy and accusing.
